statement: The function returns a result r and r equals the minimum cardinality of a set S of nodes of the tree such that every node is monitored by S. A node v is monitored by S iff v is in S, or the parent of v (if v is not the root) is in S, or at least one immediate child of v (if v has such a child) is in S. Formally, let Nodes(root) be the set of nodes reachable from root by left and right child links. Then r = min { |S| : S is a subset of Nodes(root) and for every v in Nodes(root), v is in S or parent(v) is in S or leftChild(v) is in S or rightChild(v) is in S }, ignoring nonexistent parents and Null children.
preconditions: root is not Null; the number of nodes in the tree rooted at root is between 1 and 1000; every Node in the tree has value 0.

statement: The function returns a result r; it does not fail, panic, go out of bounds, or overflow during execution.
preconditions: root is not Null; the number of nodes in the tree rooted at root is between 1 and 1000; every Node in the tree has value 0.

statement: Let N be the number of nodes in the tree rooted at root. The function returns a result r and 1 <= r <= N.
preconditions: root is not Null; the number of nodes in the tree rooted at root is between 1 and 1000; every Node in the tree has value 0.

statement: The function returns a result r and there exists a set S of nodes of the tree such that |S| = r and every node of the tree is monitored by S, where a camera at a node monitors that node, its parent if any, and its immediate children if any.
preconditions: root is not Null; the number of nodes in the tree rooted at root is between 1 and 1000; every Node in the tree has value 0.

statement: The function returns a result r and for every set S of nodes of the tree, if every node of the tree is monitored by S (with the same monitoring definition: a camera at a node monitors that node, its parent if any, and its immediate children if any), then |S| >= r.
preconditions: root is not Null; the number of nodes in the tree rooted at root is between 1 and 1000; every Node in the tree has value 0.

statement: The function returns a result r and r = ceil(N/3), where ceil(N/3) is the least integer k such that 3*k >= N.
preconditions: The tree rooted at root is a path with N >= 4 nodes: every node has at most one child, and every node has value 0. Let N be the number of nodes.

statement: The function returns a result r when called on root and a result r_mirror when called on mirrorRoot, and r = r_mirror.
preconditions: root is not Null; the tree rooted at root has between 1 and 1000 nodes; every node has value 0; and mirrorRoot is the tree obtained from root by recursively swapping the left and right children at every node, keeping the same node values.

statement: Let I be the number of nodes in the tree rooted at root that have at least one child. The function returns a result r and r <= I.
preconditions: root is not Null; the tree rooted at root has between 2 and 1000 nodes; every node has value 0.
